title: Empathic.X — Buttes-Chaumont
summary: Five walkable districts in Parc des Buttes-Chaumont: a grove for reading the self, a commons for reading others, a cliff-top repair hall, a lakeside plaza for reading the room, and a workshop pavilion for emotion at work.

buildings.name: Commons Listening Circle
buildings.use: open-air forum for asking over assuming

buildings.name: Cliff-Top Repair Hall
buildings.use: temple-style hall for apologies and hard conversations

buildings.name: Come-Down Tower
buildings.use: de-escalation stair tower on the cliff

buildings.name: Lakeside Room-Reader Plaza
buildings.use: open plaza for sensing group energy

buildings.name: Practitioner Workshop Barn
buildings.use: skills hall for feedback and saying no

court.name: The Repair Court
court.style: cliff-top open colonnade above the lake
court.why_here: The park's real temple viewpoint above Buttes-Chaumont lake gives gravity and distance — a fitting high place to come down, apologise properly, and speak kindly.

quests.title: Three States This Week
steps: Sit at the Body-Signal Cabin and name three states you were in this week
Mark where each landed in your body on the body map
Carry one named state to the Question Well and ask someone about theirs
Log the exchange on the commons chalkboard

quests.title: The Assumption Bin
steps: Write an assumption you made about a face at the kiosk
Drop it in the Assumption Bin and rewrite it as a question
Ask the rewritten question at the Listening Circle
Read the plaza's energy barometer and note who was idle while you asked

quests.title: Stay In It
steps: Spot the moment before the room goes wrong at the plaza
Climb the Come-Down Stair to cool off
Deliver a proper apology at the Apology Court
Practice receiving an apology in the Receiving Room without deflecting

quests.title: Feedback That Lands
steps: Pick a hard-kind sentence from the repair ledger
Forge it into usable feedback at the Feedback Forge
Say no cleanly once in the No-Saying Room
Record the emotional labour cost on the ledger

quests.title: Leaving Well
steps: Visit the Colleague Care Corner for someone struggling
Pass the Leaving-Well Gate and write an exit line
Return to the grove and name the state it left in you
Mark it on the body map at the cabin
